name: ef2inv_design
description: Design a binder SEQUENCE against a target protein with the ESM cookbook's gradient-guided ESMFold2 recipe. Give a built-in target name (cd45, ctla4, egfr, pd-l1, pdgfr) or any label plus its 'target_sequence', and a 'binder_len'. Returns each design's binder sequence and the four hero critics' scores; the refolded structure is opt-in. One design is a fixed 150-step optimisation -- the step count is the recipe's own constant and cannot be lowered.

target_name.description: A built-in target (cd45, ctla4, egfr, pd-l1, pdgfr: the recipe's own sequences, give no target_sequence), or any label for a target_sequence you supply.

target_sequence.description: The target's amino-acid sequence, required when target_name is not one of the built-ins and forbidden when it is. Up to 280 residues.

binder_len.description: Length of the binder to design, 8-200. target_len + binder_len must not exceed 300 tokens.

n_designs.description: How many designs to run (default 1, max 4). Each is an independent 150-step optimisation at seed+k, run one after another: the count costs time, not memory.

seed.description: Random seed of the first design.

target_hotspot_ids.description: Target residue ids to treat as the epitope, e.g. ["56", "57"]. Omit to let the recipe choose.

epitope_contact_distance.description: The recipe's epitope contact distance in angstroms.

warm_only.description: Run the recipe's one-time costs and a single design-step-shaped gradient pass instead of a design (seconds rather than minutes). Use it to check that the provider is live and what it costs on this card.

return_structures.description: Return each design's refolded mmCIF text (default false: hundreds of kilobytes per design).
